report_discrepancies.note: The trimmed PDF holds two different proprietary statements of revenues, expenses and changes in net position: p7 (report p10, Modified Cash Basis) ends at net position 1,358,094 (ties to the proprietary Statement of Net Position p6 and the government-wide p1/p2); p16 (report p37) ends at 1,431,994, with beginning 1,389,500, charges for services 481,837 and operating expenses 446,354. p7 was used for the business-type roll-forward.

The Water/Sewer combining schedule (report p43) ties to the p16 version: Combined Utility charges for services 415,115 vs 403,364 on p7; operating expenses 382,218 vs 392,700; interest expense 2,066 vs 2,216. Detail recorded as printed on p18.

notes: Modified cash basis (recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Totals column of the governmental funds statement (p4-p5); fund balances 990,024 / 993,252 (p5) recorded as fund balance, cash fields null as in the later years (fund assets are cash, CDs, county treasurer cash and restricted cash, p3). Taxes 430,761 split by the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2), which tie to the General (p11) and Street (p13) tax lines. Intergovernmental 528,490 split by the General Fund (p11), Street Fund (p13) and nonmajor (p15 State grants) lines. Miscellaneous 223,414 split by p11, p13, p15 lines plus the Ambulance Board column's 6,298 (p4; no schedule). Loan proceeds 92,800 (other financing sources) recorded as debt_proceeds. Transfers in/out 1,000 each from the Totals column (General 19,500 in / Sinking 18,500 out within the General Fund; Lottery 1,000 out). Business-type: Combined Utility + Sanitation from p7 (operating + nonoperating); proprietary Miscellaneous 8,684 is counted in Charges for Services on p2. proprietary cash flows left null as in the later years. Detail: General Fund combining schedule by department column (p11-p12), Street Fund schedule (p13), nonmajor combining statement (p15, Lottery/Fire Board/Cemetery Board), proprietary Water/Sewer combining schedule (p18) and Sanitation from the p7 column; Ambulance Board fund has no schedule (no detail). The all-funds budget statement (p10) is not recorded (combined across funds; per-fund schedules exist). Capital outlay in the General department column has no printed function (plain Capital Outlay). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (includes capital assets and debt), per column. Read pages 1-18 of 18
